subject.title: Add sms.read command and SMS as a messaging channel

question: Should Android-device SMS be accepted as a separate node-backed SMS command/channel surface, and what ownership, naming, and security boundary should it use alongside the existing Twilio-backed `sms` plugin?
rationale: The remaining work is real, but it changes sensitive Android permissions, inbound model activation, outbound carrier-SMS authority, and an existing `sms` channel/config namespace.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Define a narrow `sms.read` contract separately from any Android-device channel, then choose the channel id/plugin/API/security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Android device channel
options.body: Accept a node-backed Android SMS channel only with a dedicated namespace, fail-closed sender policy, redaction/audit behavior, and live device proof.

options.title: Do not add device SMS
options.body: Close or narrow this to the existing Twilio SMS plugin if maintainers decide Android-device SMS privacy and carrier-send authority are out of scope.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow `sms.read` contract separately from any Android-device channel, then choose the channel id/plugin/API/security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision intersects the current Twilio `sms` channel namespace and product/plugin boundary most directly.
